value: The program wrapped around the model: system prompt, tools (read/edit/run), permission gates, transcript management. You never talk to a raw model.
Model proposes an action → harness executes → result feeds back, until the stopping condition is met. Remove the loop and you have a chatbot.
A falsifiable finish line written BEFORE the goal is run (e.g. 'these three tests pass, no other files touched').
One goal, one agent run, one verify step. Kitchen-sink sessions (many goals, one thread) are the canonical failure.
All paste-blocks default to opencode. Variant lines for Claude Code / Codex CLI / Gemini CLI only where commands differ.
Sessions run in scratch repos (mkdir, 1-3 files) unless the brief justifies more. Reproducible from zero.
Every factual claim with a URL must match a docs/source-ledger.md row verbatim. New facts need new ledger rows first.

Inline SVG only. Palette roles: ink structure, accent motion/emphasis, go pass/done, stop fail/wall. Every arrow labeled with a verb. Caption starts 'Fig. N —'. Motion dies under prefers-reduced-motion.
Semantic HTML, 3px focus rings, ≥38px (44px preferred) tap targets, shape+label never color alone, dark theme first-class, no blue.
